data.title: Spaces with clarity, comfort, and purpose.
data.subtitle: Bespoke window treatments, interior design, automation, and repair for homes, workplaces, and care environments.

content.en: With more than 10 years in the industry, the studio brings design thinking and practical installation together. Explore selected projects, services, and materials.

pages.title: Projects
pages.meta_description: Selected commercial and interior window treatment projects across Auckland and New Zealand.

content.en: From healthcare privacy systems and commercial workspaces to residential shutters and curtains, each project responds to its setting and use.

pages.title: Services
pages.meta_description: Window treatment manufacture, installation, repair, automation, and interior design services.

content.en: We manufacture, install, alter, repair, and automate window treatments, and provide considered interior design for residential and commercial spaces.

pages.title: Products
pages.meta_description: Shutters, curtain tracks, textiles, and window treatment materials selected for performance and finish.

content.en: Talk with the studio about shutters, curtain tracks, textiles, and the right material palette for your space.

pages.title: About
pages.meta_description: An Auckland studio balancing durable materials, natural light, and practical detailing.

content.en:
Ultimate Space Design is an Auckland architecture and interior design studio dedicated to environments that resonate with their context. The studio's approach is reductive, balancing heavy materials such as concrete and stone with glass and light.

The wider practice also provides comprehensive commercial and residential window treatment solutions with quality-controlled in-house manufacture.
